subject.title: feat(agents): per-agent outbound A2A allowlist override

question: Should OpenClaw accept this focused outbound-only per-agent A2A allowlist contract now, or fold it into the broader per-agent/per-capability session authorization design?
rationale: The PR changes public config, plugin-SDK policy shape, and cross-agent authorization semantics; those are security-boundary and upgrade-sensitive choices that automation should not settle.

options.title: Approve focused contract after fixes
options.body: Accept outbound-only per-agent A2A allowlists once the normalization and changelog findings are repaired and exact-head validation is green.

options.title: Fold into broader authorization design
options.body: Pause this branch and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59149 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48785 the place to choose one complete session authorization model.

options.title: Reject per-agent A2A for now
options.body: Close or decline this PR if maintainers do not want another public config knob on the session authorization surface.

recommendation.title: Approve focused contract after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept outbound-only per-agent A2A allowlists once the normalization and changelog findings are repaired and exact-head validation is green.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant session authorization/config history and recent allowlist hardening most clearly route to steipete among the inspected owners.
